name: Aozora Primary School
description: A calm, photograph-led theme for a small independent primary school: morning-white ground, chalk-stone bands and ink text with a single fujinezu (wisteria grey #6E75A4) accent, Alegreya over Alegreya Sans. The home page opens with a morning classroom photograph inset with large rounded corners and a notched corner over a pale band, the headline set as three stacked caption lines overlapping its edge, a dashed open-morning note and three equal gateways (visit, apply, families); then a welcome from the head, a school day as a horizontal strip of photographs, teachers by name, what children learn on a band with a slanted soft-wave edge, admissions steps with the fees and open days as plain lists, the journal and a visit invitation with overlapping photographs, a pill bar and a ring-text badge. With A school day, Curriculum, Teachers, Admissions, Fees and open days, About, Contact, Parents' letter and Journal. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German.

summary.en: A calm primary-school theme: a morning classroom in a notched frame, a school day in photographs, teachers by name, admissions, fees and open days.

summary.ja: 落ち着いた私立小学校のテーマ。切り欠きの枠に朝の教室、写真でたどる一日、先生の紹介、入試・学費・学校説明会。
summary.fr: Thème sobre pour école primaire privée : la classe du matin, une journée en photos, les enseignants, inscriptions, frais et portes ouvertes.
